title: AC1027 Cover TABLESTYLE versus ODA R24 layout differential

source.provenanceLimit: Existing local source; producer is not independently authenticated and no drawing fixture is committed.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, v5.4.1
relevantRules: R24 repeated TABLESTYLE cell styles are described in data, title, header order.
Cell style IDs 1/2/3 identify title/header/data; class 1 means data and class 2 means label.
Cell style text-style handles and border linetype handles are hard pointers.
authority.note: The exact AGENTS.md PDF path without a suffix is absent in this checkout; the local '(1)' copy is byte-identical to /Users/dli/doc/dwg/dwg.pdf and was used for this comparison.

implementationEvidence.parseBehavior: The R24 parser reads each repeated style record in loop order, reads the record ID/class/name, and appends it directly to m_cellStyles; it does not reorder by name or ID.
implementationEvidence.writerAndGeneratedControl: The generated AC1024/AC1027 writer and roundtrip controls preserve the same in-memory list order; they are encoder/parser consistency, not independent proof of Cover's physical field interpretation.

independentReaderExecution.result: ACadSharp reads TABLESTYLE 0x6A and maps Table=class 2/Label, _DATA=class 2/Label, _TITLE=class 1/Data, _HEADER=class 1/Data; all three text-style references resolve to handle 0x11. Its source parses repeated records in sequence then binds named roles in the template builder. The high-level object does not expose the original repeated-record order or raw field spans.

sampleWitness.repositoryProvenanceLimit: Tracked ACadSharp repository sample; producer provenance is not independently authenticated.
sampleWitness.result: ACadSharp reports the same TABLESTYLE roles and classes as Cover. libdxfrw did not reach TABLESTYLE in this file; it stops at TABLES with error 9 and two null-member controls, so this does not independently corroborate the local parser.

writerSource.observedCodeBehavior: The R24 writer enumerates title, header, then data styles; ACadSharp default cell-style classes assign Data=1 to title/header and Label=2 to data/table. This library-internal convention conflicts with ODA section 20.4.101.2/20.4.101.4 and is not independent normative evidence.

differential.order: Local parsed order is title/header/data; ODA documents data/title/header.
differential.classMeaning: Local classes are 1/1/2 for title/header/data, while ODA defines class 1 as data and class 2 as label.
differential.resolution: The independent raw cursor confirms the physical repeated order is title/header/data, with IDs 1/2/3 and classes 1/1/2. ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.101.2 specifies data/title/header order and §20.4.101.4 defines class 1 as data and class 2 as label. ACadSharp reports the same named roles/classes but does not expose its raw order, and its writer follows the same internal convention. These results confirm a real source/spec interpretation conflict, not which side is correct. Keep the profile unqualified and make no parser or writer normalization without a second independent raw-span/semantic witness.

nextAction: Find an eligible second AC1027 producer/consumer witness that exposes raw repeated-record order and named-role/class interpretation. If none is immediately available, keep Cover strict output refused and continue another source-ready local implementation slice; do not retry ODA’s unchanged direct launch.
